Comprehensive technical training and ongoing support will be provided, giving you full exposure to industry-leading sports technology systems and live match operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in elite football environments, live broadcast technology, and high-performance sports operations at the highest level of the game.

This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain practical, hands-on experience in sports technology while maintaining a flexible routine. Because live matchday operations follow the football fixture calendar - predominantly concentrated on weekends with occasional midweek commitments for training and fixtures - we are seeking candidates with strong availability to cover these key operational windows.

Why Is This The Right Job For You?

We’re looking for individuals who are reliable, professional, and passionate about football. This position is perfect for you if you possess:

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

  • A passion for innovation

  • A willingness to learn

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment

  • Flexible schedule with primary weekend availability

  • An interest in the sport of Football

 

Skills and Requirements

Essential Criteria and Skills

  • Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of computer hardware, networking, and fibre-optic connectivity, with a quick aptitude for learning in-house technology and software.

  • Professionalism: High level of professionalism and a calm, solutions-focused attitude when working in highly visible, client-facing scenarios.

  • Mobility: A full UK driving license

  • Passion: Strong football knowledge and a genuine interest in the sport.

 

Desirable/Bonus Skills & Experience:

  • Broadcast and Live events experience

  • Video routing Knowledge

  • Experience with Audio Over IP devices

 

What Difficulties Might I Face?

Up to this point, while there may be many things that you find intriguing about this role, the difficulties you may face should not be ignored.

Working Hours: Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles right to the end.

High-Pressure Situations: Working in a live broadcast environment on a production that is distributed to millions worldwide will bring high levels of pressure

You may also have the chance to:

  • Opportunities for full-time employment

  • Increase your skillset and be more involved within our team

  • Contribute to improvements in VAR workflows and cutting-edge tech development

We’ll support you every step of the way, but these are roles where focus, resilience, and professionalism are a must.

 

Team Culture

At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on a collaborative, high-performance culture where trust, passion, and innovation thrive. We believe in fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to push boundaries and contribute to the future of sports technology. Our work is guided by three core values:

  • We are Brave: We challenge the status quo, embrace big ideas, and constantly seek new ways to innovate in the sports entertainment industry. We aren't afraid to take risks in pursuit of excellence.

What you'll be doing

  • Use your analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data, and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

  • Using data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model, such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

  • Using data and analytics to drive decisions about who we should lend to, and how much we should lend to them, and how that changes with the economy and competition changes

  • Conducting hypothesis testing, and using your findings to change how we do things in areas such as lending strategy, pricing, and fraud detection

  • Presenting your findings to senior leaders in the company, then work with the product/tech team to get them implemented

 

What we're looking for

  • A graduate with a degree

  • Someone that loves numbers! You’ll be working with numbers every single day in this role so you’ll be able to demonstrate your ability to work with complex data sets, analyse them and draw insights

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:

  • Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

  • Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

  • Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

  • Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

  • Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

  • Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy

  • Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

  • Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

  • Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS

  • Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience

  • Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users

  • Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others

  • Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

Seit über 150 Jahren steht der Name unseres Klienten für Kompetenz in der Oberflächenveredelung von Metallen. Als einer der leistungsfähigsten Innovationsträger der Branche bieten wir der Industrie und dem Handwerk schnelle, kostengünstige und umweltbewusste Lösungen mit einem Höchstmaß an Professionalität und Individualität.

Dabei gehen die Kompetenzen des privat geführten Unternehmens weit über die Gal­va­nik hinaus. Denn es betreut seine Auftraggeber bereits in der Projektierungsphase neuer Bauteile oder Systemlösungen und entwickeln im Bedarfsfalle Funktionsschichten.

Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und organisatorische Leitung des Labors mit Verantwortung für einen reibungslosen Tagesbetrieb.
  • Planung, Priorisierung und Koordination von Laboraufgaben, einschließlich Ressourcen- und Kapazitätssteuerung.
  • Sicherstellung der Qualität und Nachverfolgbarkeit von Mess- und Prüfergebnissen nach geltenden Standards und Vorgaben.
  • Überwachung und Optimierung von Laborprozessen, Methoden und Arbeitsanweisungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.
  • Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborprüfungen sowie Übernahme der fachlichen Bewertung im Ergebnisprozess.
  • Koordination von Instandhaltung, Kalibrierung und Wartung relevanter Geräte in Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stellen.
  • Fachliche Führung, Unterweisung und Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeitenden im Laborbereich.
  • Mitwirkung bei Audits, Abweichungsmanagement, CAPA-Themen sowie Dokumentations- und Schulungsprozessen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Laborumfeld.
  • Umfassende Erfahrung in der Labororganisation sowie in der Durchführung und Bewertung von Laboranalysen und Prüfverfahren.
  • Nachweisliche Kenntnisse in qualitätssichernden Prozessen und dokumentationsbasiertem Arbeiten (z. B. gemäß QM-/Standardanforderungen).
  • Souveränes Arbeiten mit Laborgeräten, Messsystemen und datenbasierter Auswertung, inklusive Verstehen der technischen Zusammenhänge.
  • Fundierte Kompetenz in der Planung und Steuerung von Arbeitsabläufen, Prioritäten und Ressourcen.
  • Teamorientierte Führungs- und Kommunikationsstärke, verbunden mit klarer, strukturierter Entscheidungsfähigkeit.
  • Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit Schnittstellen (z. B. Produktion, Qualitätssicherung, Einkauf, externe Dienstleister).
  • Eigenständige, sorgfältige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen und möchten Ihr Fachwissen sowie Ihre Führungsstärke in ein Labor einbringen, das Qualität und Fortschritt konsequent verbindet? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit Ihren vollständigen Unterlagen. Zeigen Sie uns, dass Sie die richtige Laborleitung für unser Team sind.

Mein Unternehmen vermittelt seit 25 Jahren Fach- und Führungskräfte speziell aus dem Bereich der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanik, Lack-, Pulver-, KTL Beschichtungen, Feuerverzinkung). Wir sind im D-A-CH Gebiet tätig.

data.description:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Team Lead Autonomy Hardware, you will own the hardware backbone of our ground autonomy stack: the compute platform, the full sensorset (camera, radar, lidar, IMU, connectivity), and its integration into a wide range of vehicles, from partner truck OEMs and UGV manufacturers to our own Mandrill UGV.

This is a player-coach role: you will build and lead a high-performing, flexible, and experienced team while staying hands-on in design, verification, and integration. You will work at the intersection of autonomy software, vehicle manufacturers, our air and sea domains, and central supply chain, making sure our hardware is robust, reusable, and scalable.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Team Leadership 

  • Build, lead, and enable a high-performing, flexible, and experienced Autonomy Hardware team.

  • Set priorities, ensure delivery quality, and establish best practices for design, documentation, and review.

  • Stay hands-on: you challenge the design, review prototypes, and test alongside your team.

Autonomy Hardware Ownership (Compute & Sensorset)

  • Ensure that you and your team:

  • Own the autonomy compute platform and sensorset architecture: camera, radar, lidar, IMU, and connectivity.

  • Define and evolve the network topology of the autonomy kit.

  • Benchmark compute platforms and sensors and drive make/buy and vendor decisions.

  • Integrate the autonomy hardware kit into various vehicle types: trucks from OEM partners, UGVs from external partners, and our own Mandrill UGV.

  • Own mechanical, electrical, and electronic integration: mounting concepts, power, schematics,  harness design, and interfaces.

  • Design for robustness and demanding environmental conditions (vibration, temperature, EMC).

  • Drive the full design process from concept to industrialisation: schematics, harness design, CAD, and simulation.

  • Build and run VnV setups from breadboards and yellow boards to vehicle-level testing.

  • Ensure designs are manufacturable and scalable: robust design principles, composition, and industrialisation.

Cross-Functional & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work hand-in-hand with our Software and Prototyping teams to align hardware with the autonomy stack.

  • Collaborate closely with vehicle manufacturers (truck OEMs and UGV partners) as external and internal stakeholders.

  • Align with our Air and Sea domains to reuse hardware and leverage economies of scale across Quantum-Systems.

  • Partner with central Supply Chain Management across the full lifecycle: early vendor engagement, sourcing, service agreements, and delivery schedules.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a comparable field.

  • 10+ years of hands-on hardware development experience; 2+ years in a leadership or team lead role.

  • Background in automotive, defense, or robotics, ideally with experience integrating hardware into vehicles and working with OEMs.

  • Strong expertise in sensor technologies (camera, radar, lidar, IMU) and embedded/edge compute platforms.

  • Proven VnV experience: breadboards, yellow boards, benchmarking, and network topology design.

  • Command of the full hardware design process: robust design for harsh environmental conditions, schematics, harness design, CAD, simulation, and industrialisation.

  • Experience working with supply chain teams, from early vendor engagement to service agreements and delivery schedules.

  • Strong communication and project management skills across engineering, partners, and suppliers; comfortable representing hardware topics towards OEMs and internal leadership.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Player-coach mindset: high ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment.

     

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

Bereit, den Markt zu verändern?

Du möchtest eine Marke aktiv mitprägen und visuell weiterentwickeln? Für eine Elternzeitvertretung, befristet auf zwei Jahre, suchen wir einen Senior Brand & Visual Designer (m/w/d), der unsere visuelle Identität über alle Kanäle hinweg konsistent umsetzt und weiterdenkt.

Dabei bist du unser einziger Designer (m/w/d) im Team: Du arbeitest daher sehr eigenverantwortlich und hast die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Weiterentwicklung von PAIR Finance maßgeblich mitzugestalten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen Teams und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast viel Ownership und Gestaltungsspielraum.

Von Website, Social Media und Präsentationen bis hin zu Print, Events und Messeauftritten: Du gestaltest, illustrierst und animierst und übernimmst dabei Verantwortung von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast dabei viel Ownership und Gestaltungsspielraum.

Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit CV und deinem Portfolio. Zeig uns deine visuelle Handschrift und dein Brand-Thinking. Wir möchten sehen, wie du gestaltest und wie du denkst.

Lust, die Marke PAIR Finance mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!


Was du bei uns bewegen kannst:

  • Präge und entwickle unsere visuelle Markenidentität weiter - von der kreativen Leitidee bis zur konsistenten Umsetzung über alle digitalen und physischen Kanäle hinweg.
  • Arbeite eng mit Content & PR sowie Sales, Partnerships und Product zusammen, um Inhalte visuell stimmig und unsere Marke über alle Bereiche hinweg konsistent zu gestalten.
  • Gestalte Designelemente für unterschiedlichste Formate und Kanäle - von Web, Mobile, Social Media und E-Mail bis hin zu Präsentationen und Print. Entwickle Icons, Illustrationen und einfache Animationen.
  • Gestalte Messeauftritte, Event-Materialien und Giveaways im Einklang mit unserer Markenidentität.
  • Unterstütze die Geschäftsleitung und das Partnership-Team bei Präsentationen und übersetze komplexe Inhalte und Botschaften in klare, ansprechende und markengerechte Folien. Du verantwortest außerdem die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer Mastervorlage für Sales-Pitches.
  • Präsentiere deine Ideen selbstbewusst und überzeugend gegenüber Denise Schönherr, Head of Brand & Communications, und Stephan Stricker, unserem CEO.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Projekte - von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Du behältst dabei mehrere Projekte und Prioritäten eigenständig im Blick.
  • Probiere neue Technologien aus und bringe sie in unseren Arbeitsalltag ein, insbesondere generative Bild- und Videotools.


Was du dafür mitbringen solltest:

  • Mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im B2B Brand- und Grafikdesign, in einem Inhouse-Brand-Team oder einem schnell wachsenden Startup.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Ein überzeugendes Portfolio, das dein Gespür für Marken und deine Fähigkeit zeigt, kreative Inhalte kanalübergreifend wirkungsvoll einzusetzen.
  • Starkes konzeptionelles Denken und eine klare Kommunikation. Du kannst deine Ideen überzeugend präsentieren, gibst konstruktives Feedback und stimmst dich sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern ab.
  • Organisationstalent und Eigenverantwortung. Du setzt die richtigen Prioritäten, behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und bringst Themen selbstständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop und InDesign) und Interesse an neuen Technologien. Im Idealfall hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung mit generativen AI-Tools wie z.B. Claude Design.
  • Leidenschaft für gutes Branding und Lust, neue kreative Ansätze auszuprobieren und bestehende Wege auch mal zu hinterfragen.
  • Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Motion Design, z.B. 3D-Animationen oder animierten Videos.
Bei PAIR Finance arbeiten Menschen, die Kundenzentrierung, Transparenz und Integrität nicht nur als Werte kennen, sondern danach handeln. Dazu kommt der echte Wille, Dinge voranzubringen - nicht irgendwann, sondern jetzt. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.


Was wir dir bieten:

  • Standort & Arbeitsmodell: Berlin (Charlottenburg), hybrides Arbeitsmodell

data.title: Control System Engineer (m/f/d)

data.description:
Kertos Intro

Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe.

Following our €14M Series A, backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.
With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane, leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time.

The market is growing by 20% every year, fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act. We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion.

There has never been a better moment to join our team.

Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.


Your purpose at Kertos

As Head of Product, you own Kertos's product vision and roadmap, and you're joining at a genuinely pivotal moment. The category is being redrawn: compliance is shifting from software as a service to service as software, where AI and automation do the work wherever they can and our compliance experts focus on the judgment calls that still need a human. Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will.

That means the roadmap in front of you is wide open. There are more good directions to take the product than we can pursue at once, across the segments we serve today and the ones we're growing into, and a real part of the job is choosing where to place the bets. You'll work closely with our compliance experts to understand exactly what clients need, and decide with your team and engineering where the line between automation and human judgment sits today, with the mandate to push it forward quarter after quarter as AI takes on more of the work.

This role sits at the center of the product organization and value creation. You set the roadmap across squads, and you lead and grow the product team, partnering closely with our compliance experts and building around their knowledge, their needs, and their day-to-day work. You're accountable for the roadmap, for how the product team operates, and for outcomes clients can feel directly: time saved, risk reduced, audits passed.

Your responsibilities

  • Set the product vision, defining where Kertos product goes next, the shift from compliance software clients operate themselves to a service that delivers compliance outcomes for them, and turn that vision into a roadmap built around client value, not just feature velocity.
  • Partner closely with our compliance experts to learn what actually creates value for them and our customers, and work with our Development Team to turn that expertise into a product that makes their work faster and clients' outcomes better.
  • Continue to develop and mentor four product managers and two designers as the team scales, set the standards for how they run discovery and shipping, and make sure they grow into stronger PMs under you.
  • Optimize the discovery process and work closely with compliance experts, design and engineering to understand problems deeply, validate ideas with real clients before building, and ship improvements that move a client's compliance outcome.
  • Understand needs of customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing so product bets translate into revenue, retention, and measurable value for clients, especially as features move from "helps you do compliance" to "does the compliance work for you."
  • Own the roadmap, setting priorities independently, and aligning them with technical leads, our customer advisory board, key clients, and the leadership team.
  • Use data to define what success looks like for each initiative in terms clients would recognize, such as “time saved”, “risk mitigated”, “time to audit readiness”, and work with Marketing and Customer Success to turn usage data into the next round of decisions.



The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring

  • You've led product strategy in B2B SaaS as a Head of Product or similar, at a startup, scale-up, or an agile team inside a larger company and ideally have taken a product from idea through GA more than once.
  • You've hired, mentored, and managed product managers before, and know how to set clear expectations and give feedback that actually helps.
  • You successfully partner with compliance or legal experts who aren't engineers and turn their knowledge into product requirements
  • You are passionate about AI and enjoy using it to define new product processes
  • You are an ambitious and driven high-performer that wants to have a high impact on changing how compliance work gets done, excited about new user flows and AI-driven automation and is excited to take our compliance service & software product to series B ready.
  • Big plus if you bring technical engineering expertise that helps you to discuss frontend, backend, and cloud architecture and you can successfully turn complex technical and compliance topics into clear direction for engineering, sales, leadership, and customers.
  • Familiarity with GRC, information security, or privacy topics would be a great plus point, too.
  • German language skills are required for this position.


Why Kertos

  • You are Kertos: Don’t like something? Could be done better? You have the freedom to push things forward and contribute to making Kertos a great place to work
  • Unique opportunity: Join the growing team of one of Europe’s most promising early stages companies and to work directly with our COO Joe
  • European funding in the millions: The EU has funded our AI research with a total of over 2 million euros
  • Regular Feedback: We foster an open feedback culture and support your growth with regular 1-on-1 meetings
  • Full Flexibility: Whether at the Berlin office, our Munich HQ or at your home office – we are flexible, and you'll be happy
  • Keep growing: To boost your professional and personal growth, we provide you with a Personal Development Budget of 1.500€ per year
  • Cutting Edge Technology: Leading VCs have invested in our vision to revolutionize how compliance measures are handled sustainably
  • Mental Health: We've partnered with nilo to prioritize your well-being, offering personalized mental health support for all employees
  • For Sports Enthusiasts: We subsidize your Wellpass membership for your physical fitness for a better work-life balance
  • Steep learning curve: With us you get full responsibility from day 1, push topics forward independently and thus learn a lot
  • Strong onboarding: No idea about compliance and its automation? No problem, we'll turn you into an expert and provide you with an onboarding buddy
  • Teamwork Makes the Dream Work: We are a strong team that supports each other, and we also have a lot of fun together beyond work and across different locations


Sounds like you are the one we’ve been looking for?

Perfect, let's have a chat! Just send in your CV. We are excited to meet you soon.
In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our People & Culture team. We're happy to answer all your questions.

Location: Berlin (Hybrid, 2+ days/week in office); open for candidates willing to relocate to Berlin


About koppla

At koppla, we're a fun and ambitious team on a mission to help the construction industry build more efficiently. We're already partnering with top construction companies and delivering impressive results for our customers (multi-months speed-ups discovered through koppla).

Our ambitions are backed by leading VCs (Earlybird, Newion) and industry angels as we tackle a billion-dollar opportunity problem in an underdigitized and underserved market.

Our culture is core to who we are and we've built one we're genuinely proud of. We are not looking for hypergrowth - we believe in hiring slowly to create an environment of few but very high-performing team members that build a truly great product (similar to Netflix, Ashby or Linear).


What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and engineers to design and implement new features in a truly cross-functional process.

Our Tech Stack: 
  • Frontend: Typescript, Vue 3, Tailwind, Netlify, GH Actions

Who we're looking for

This role is perfect for a Frontend/Full Stack Engineer with 2-5 years of experience looking to grow their skills and make a meaningful impact at a company that is approaching product-market fit (> €2.5M ARR). You are likely a great fit if:

  • Du übernimmst unternehmerische Verantwortung und bringst komplexe Digitalisierungsprojekte konsequent zu messbaren Ergebnissen.
  • Du bist bereit, abhängig vom Kundenprojekt regelmäßig vor Ort zu arbeiten und die dafür notwendige Reisetätigkeit zu übernehmen.


Das kannst du von uns erwarten

Kultur und Zusammenhalt

Bei MEONDI erwartet dich eine Kultur geprägt von Offenheit, Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Wir glauben an unternehmerisches Denken, Eigenverantwortung und daran, dass nachhaltige Lösungen nur im echten Dialog entstehen.

Du erhältst den Freiraum, deine Aufgaben selbstständig zu gestalten. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und auf Ergebnisorientierung statt Präsenzkultur.

Mobile Working ist bei uns gelebte Realität. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub ermöglichen dir, Beruf und Leben in Einklang zu bringen – ob remote, in einem unserer Hubs oder beim Kunden.

Wir statten dich mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung (MacBook, iPhone auch privat nutzbar) aus und schaffen klare, professionelle Projektstrukturen.

Individuelles Coaching, regelmäßige Austauschformate und transparente Quartalsmeetings mit Einblick in Strategie und Unternehmensentwicklung sorgen dafür, dass du fachlich wie persönlich wachsen kannst.

Unsere Hubs sind bewusst als Orte für Workshops, Reviews und Zusammenarbeit konzipiert. Wir schaffen Räume für echten Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.

At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!
We are recruiting for our Dusseldorf Office where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 100 people.

Consultants based in Dusseldorf will support clients in Germany and across Europe with opportunity to travel globally. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

As a Senior Consultant (SC), you will have complete ownership of complex workstreams or several smaller workstreams and be supported by junior resources. You should be deemed as a subject matter expert (SME) both internally and by clients and you will be responsible for the following:
  • Managing complex workstreams or multiple smaller workstreams. Often supported by junior resources
  • Managing more junior consultants on projects, making sure Efficio methodologies and processes are followed
  • Driving complex analysis where data is hard to access and using expertise to creatively develop conclusions and recommended solutions
  • Playing a role in advising clients and designing solutions that address complex needs, achieve sustainable results, and demonstrate real impact
  • Effectively managing and owning the relationship with senior stakeholders
  • Planning and preparing documentation for own workstream
  • Taking part in the recruitment process of potential junior consultants
    • Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients - and so we're looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.
     
    We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities alongside comfortable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. We're looking for team members who enjoy and have experience of digging into complex challenges at a leading management consultancy or in a relevant industry position.
     
    Strong opportunities for career growth are an important part of our offering; as such, we love seeing ambition and a proactive approach to shaping your career to your goals and interests.
     
    To meet client needs, we look for flexibility to travel; you can give us a heads-up on your preferences when applying.
     
    We'd love to hear about any additional skills or experiences you bring to the table. We're particularly interested in:
    • Fluency in German and English
    • Management consulting experience within a leading consultancy, ideally within procurement and/or supply chain
    • Experience (or an interest) in strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, or capital projects
    • Proven track record of working closely with senior client stakeholders
    • Deep analytical skills and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate key issues and draw sound conclusions
    • Strong grasp of detail and a 'hands-on' approach
    • Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills
    • Ability to confidently improve existing ways of working, recognize opportunities and identify innovative solutions that add real value to clients

DateYork ist Teil der P&W Love Events GmbH und bringt seit 2011 Menschen im echten Leben zusammen. Wir veranstalten Speed Dating Events sowie unter unserer Marke You and Mee moderne Single Partys, Walks und besondere Eventformate in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

Was uns ausmacht: Wir sind ein wachsendes, modernes Eventunternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und immer neuen Projekten. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach Personalvorgänge ab – du sorgst mit dafür, dass in zahlreichen Städten besondere Events und echte Begegnungen entstehen.

Aufgaben

Bei uns verwaltest du nicht einfach Personal – du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Events stattfinden und die richtigen Menschen vor Ort sind.

• Du findest und gewinnst neue Moderator:innen, Event-Guides und Veranstaltungspersonal für unsere Events in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

• Du führst Bewerbungsgespräche am Telefon, lernst unterschiedliche Menschen kennen und entwickelst schnell ein Gefühl dafür, wer wirklich zu uns passt.

• Du übernimmst eigenständig die Personalplanung für unsere Events – von der ersten Anfrage bis zur finalen Besetzung.

• Du bleibst dran: Du telefonierst, schreibst, fasst nach und sorgst dafür, dass offene Positionen nicht offen bleiben.

• Wenn kurzfristig jemand absagt, wartest du nicht auf eine Lösung – du findest eine.

• Du betreust unser bestehendes Eventpersonal, koordinierst Einsätze und stellst sicher, dass alle rechtzeitig alle wichtigen Informationen und Briefings erhalten.

• Du baust unseren Personalpool kontinuierlich weiter aus, damit wir auch in neuen Städten schnell auf gute und zuverlässige Menschen zurückgreifen können.

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Personalbesetzung unserer größeren You and Mee Events – von unseren regelmäßigen Formaten bis zu Highlights wie Halloween und Silvester.

Was uns dabei wichtig ist: Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig, bist schnell, verbindlich und möchtest am Ende deines Arbeitstages sehen, was du geschafft hast. Du bekommst bei uns Verantwortung und den Freiraum, deinen Bereich wirklich voranzubringen.

Qualifikation

Für uns zählt nicht der perfekte Lebenslauf, sondern deine Einstellung: Du arbeitest gerne, übernimmst Verantwortung und möchtest etwas erreichen.

• Du beherrschst Deutsch sehr sicher in Wort und Schrift und formulierst professionelle, freundliche E-Mails selbstständig.

• Du telefonierst gerne und gehst offen, sympathisch und selbstbewusst auf unterschiedliche Menschen zu.

• Du bist absolut zuverlässig und verbindlich. Wenn du etwas übernimmst, können wir uns darauf verlassen, dass es erledigt wird.

• Du arbeitest selbstständig, denkst mit und suchst bei Problemen aktiv nach Lösungen, statt auf die nächste Anweisung zu warten.

• Du arbeitest zügig und konzentriert, bleibst dran und hast den Anspruch, deine Aufgaben wirklich abzuschließen.

• Du bist gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Events, Städten und Ansprechpartner:innen den Überblick.

• Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und kannst einschätzen, wer zuverlässig ist und zu unseren Veranstaltungen passt.

• Du bist digital fit und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Tools und Prozesse ein.

• Erfahrung im Recruiting, Personalbereich, Eventmanagement, Kundenservice oder Vertrieb ist von Vorteil – aber kein Muss.

Was für uns am Ende zählt: Du bist jemand, auf den man sich verlassen kann, der Verantwortung nicht nur übernimmt, sondern auch wirklich trägt und Lust darauf hat, gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen.

Benefits

• 100 % Remote und ortsunabhängig: Arbeite dort, wo du am besten bist. Grundsätzlich ist nach Absprache auch das Arbeiten aus dem Ausland möglich.

• Eine feste 3-Tage-Woche: Dienstag, Donnerstag und Freitag jeweils von 12:00 bis 18:00 Uhr.

• 17 € brutto pro Stunde bei 18 Stunden pro Woche.

• Echte Verantwortung statt Beschäftigungstherapie: Du bekommst deinen eigenen Bereich und den Freiraum, ihn selbstständig zu organisieren.

• Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, klares Feedback und viel Vertrauen, wenn du Verantwortung übernimmst.

• Direkte Kommunikation und möglichst wenig unnötige Meetings oder komplizierte Strukturen.

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag rund um Menschen, Dating, Events und immer wieder neue Projekte.

• Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Prozesse zu verbessern und sichtbar etwas zu bewegen.

• Eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen mit der Möglichkeit, bei guter Entwicklung mehr Verantwortung und Stunden zu übernehmen.

Revenue Operations – Working Student

Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

 

Unsere Mission für dich

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen. Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.


Das Team

Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Angebote und Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie

  • Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern.

  • CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen

 

Nach wem wir suchen

  • Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen.

  • Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden.

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten.

     

Deine ersten 6 Wochen:

  • Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis zu unserem Geschäftsmodell, unserem Produkt und den energiewirtschaftlichen Kontext aufgebaut.

  • Du hast unser CRM-, CPQ- und Reporting-Setup vollständig kennengelernt und kannst dich selbstständig in Deal-Daten und Pipeline-Ansichten orientieren.

  • Du steuerst unsere Deal-Desk-Prozesse selbstständig.

  • Du hast dich als verlässliche Ansprechperson im Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um Deals und die Angebotsprozesse etabliert.

     

Warum wir?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Die Position: Bereits ab der ersten Woche verantwortest du ein Format für unsere Kund:innen – von der Recherche über den Entwurf bis zur Veröffentlichung. Gleichzeitig schreibst du Inhalte für Suchmaschinen und siehst direkt, welche Wirkung deine Texte erzielen.

Verantwortung und Unterstützung: Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für dein eigenes Format und arbeitest dabei mit einem erfahrenen Team zusammen, das deine Arbeit sorgfältig prüft und dir konkretes Feedback gibt, wie du sie weiter verbessern kannst.

Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt – einschließlich einer realistischen Möglichkeit, nach deinem Studium dauerhaft bei uns einzusteigen.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Dich erwarten eine attraktive Vergütung, Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft.

 

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite

Über die Stelle

Du möchtest dich für Pressefreiheit und eine aufgeklärte Gesellschaft einsetzen und bringst Interesse an internationaler und interkultureller journalistischer Zusammenarbeit mit? Dann setze deine redaktionellen Fähigkeiten für CORRECTIV.Exile ein.

CORRECTIV.Exile unterstützt Journalist*innen im Exil und schafft Plattformen für ihre Stimmen und ihre Arbeit. Ein zentraler Teil davon ist redaktionelle und mediale Zusammenarbeit: Wir begleiten exilierte Journalist*innen bei Recherchen, unterstützen sie beim Fact-Checking und bei der Aufbereitung ihrer Geschichten für ein deutschsprachiges Publikum.

Für diese besondere Arbeit suchen wir ab dem 01. Oktober 2026 eine*n Werkstudent*in zunächst befristet auf ein Jahr (mit Aussicht auf Verlängerung), die*der redaktionell und medial mit unserer Exile-Community zusammenarbeitet. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 15 bis 20 Stunden in der Woche (max. 80 im Monat).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt exilierte Journalist*innen bei der redaktionellen Aufbereitung, Recherche und dem Fact-Checking ihrer Beiträge.
  • Du hilfst bei der Übersetzung sowie sprachlichen Bearbeitung von Texten aus dem Englischen ins Deutsche und stellst journalistische und stilistische Qualität sicher.
  • Du recherchierst eigenständig zu Themen rund um Pressefreiheit, Exiljournalismus und die Arbeit der Community.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Verifikation von Quellen, Daten und Fakten für Veröffentlichungen.
  • Du bringst dich in die Vor- und Nachbereitung von Talk-Formaten, Workshops sowie anderen Veranstaltungen ein und unterstützt vor Ort bei der Umsetzung (1-2 Abende pro Monat, in Berlin).
  • Du stehst im engen Austausch mit der Community der Exilmedien, um ihre journalistischen Anliegen und Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und redaktionell zu unterstützen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule eingeschrieben (gültige Immatrikulationsbescheinigung).
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1); weitere Fremdsprachen sind immer eine Bereicherung.
  • Du hast erste praktische Erfahrung im journalistischen oder redaktionellen Bereich – z. B. durch Volontariate, Praktika, freie Mitarbeit, Uni-Zeitung oder eigene Veröffentlichungen (bspw. Artikel, Recherchen, Reportagen o. Ä.).
  • Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit oder ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Fact-Checking und journalistischer Verifikationsarbeit.
  • Du arbeitest sauber und präzise, mit einem guten Gespür für journalistische Sorgfalt und Quellenkritik.
  • Du bist interkulturell sensibel und interessiert an der Arbeit mit Exilmedien-Communities.
  • Du bist motiviert, die Ziele von CORRECTIV.Exile aktiv mitzugestalten und dich für Pressefreiheit einzusetzen.


Das bieten wir

  • Ein motiviertes, internationales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, das sich auf dich und deine Unterstützung freut.
  • Die Möglichkeit dich und deine Ideen proaktiv in einem gesellschaftlich relevanten Projekt einzubringen und aktiv an Pressefreiheit und Demokratie mitzuwirken.
  • Ein Gehalt zwischen 16 und 20 Euro/Stunde – abhängig von deiner Vorerfahrung.
  • Die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeiten weitestgehend flexibel einzuteilen, passend zu deinem Studium und deinen Bedürfnissen - Homeoffice ist in Absprache teilweise möglich.
  • Regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche sowie die Möglichkeit, redaktionelle Verantwortlichkeiten zu erweitern.
  • Unmittelbare Einblicke in die Arbeit mit Journalist*innen im Exil und internationale Netzwerke.


So bewirbst du dich

Sende uns bitte bis zum 13. September 2026 deinen Lebenslauf (möglichst ohne Foto), Arbeitsproben (wenn vorhanden, z. B. veröffentlichte Artikel, Recherchen oder Textproben) und ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, in dem du auf folgende Fragen eingehst:

  • Welche journalistische oder redaktionelle Erfahrung bringst du mit, etwa im Schreiben, im Recherchieren oder beim Fact-Checking?
  • Was macht für dich einen sorgfältig recherchierten und faktengeprüften Beitrag aus? Worauf legst du bei journalistischer Arbeit besonderen Wert?
  • Welche Veröffentlichung eines Exilmediums/Exiljournalisten hat dich zuletzt begeistert und warum?
​​​Wir behalten uns vor, bereits im Ausschreibungszeitraum erste Gespräche mit Bewerbenden zu führen.

Falls du noch Fragen zur Stelle hast, kontaktiere gerne Viera Zuborova.

Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain security solutions for our cloud-native infrastructure and AI systems. This role will be responsible for securing our platform across multiple cloud environments, ensuring container and Kubernetes security, protecting AI/ML workflows, and implementing robust security controls throughout our SDLC. The ideal candidate will have deep technical and programmatic expertise in cloud-native security, along with demonstrable hands-on experience securing AI/ML systems.

 

Your responsibilities and decisions:

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Design and implement comprehensive security architectures for cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Implement security best practices for container and Kubernetes deployments

  • Develop and maintain secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) codebases

  • Design and deploy zero-trust network architecture and secure service mesh solutions

  • Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines following DevSecOps principles

AI/ML Security

  • Secure AI-powered product features end to end, covering context assembly, tool invocation, and output handling

  • Design and review security controls for RAG implementations

  • Secure agentic solutions and their extension points: tool integrations (MCP clients and servers), agent skills, and autonomous action boundaries such as scoped credentials, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop gates

  • Build defenses against direct and indirect prompt injection and other adversarial inputs to LLM applications

  • Establish data security controls for sensitive data flowing through inference, retrieval, and fine-tuning

Security Operations

  • Lead incident response for cloud and AI infrastructure security incidents

  • Develop and implement security monitoring and detection strategies

  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for cloud-native and AI systems

  • Perform regular security assessments of cloud infrastructure and container deployments

  • Create and maintain security documentation, including policies, procedures, and run-books

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with development, data science, and operations teams to integrate security

  • Communicate security requirements and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Stay current with emerging threats and security trends in cloud-native and AI security

  • Participate in technology selections for security tooling and platforms

Your profile:

 

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in information security, with at least 3 years specializing in cloud security

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience securing containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Demonstrable hands-on experience securing AI/ML or LLM-based systems

  • Strong background in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Technical Skills

  • Expert knowledge of container security, Kubernetes security, and cloud-native security patterns

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)

  • Strong understanding of network security, identity management, and access control

  • Experience with security tooling for cloud environments (Cloud Security Posture Management, CSPM)

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML and LLM security, including familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch and their security implications

  • Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, Go, Bash)

  • Experience with security automation and orchestration

Preferred Experience

  • Deep experience securing Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI systems

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security frameworks (e.g., OWASP LLM Top 10) and AI governance or compliance requirements

  • Experience with secure multi-tenant AI infrastructure

  • Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies for AI/ML (differential privacy, federated learning)

  • Contributions to open-source security projects or public security research

  • Experience building security tools or automation frameworks

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments.

About the Role

Focused Energy is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer II to help build reliable, secure, observable, and easy-to-operate systems for its internal applications. You’ll own day-to-day reliability, deployments, incident response, monitoring, backup, recovery, and rollback processes across a broad technical environment spanning cloud services, databases, identity, networking, secrets, and CI/CD.

 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex operational problems and turning recurring incidents into lasting improvements. Alongside your core infrastructure responsibilities, you’ll provide overflow support for AI-enablement workflows and tools when the dedicated AI Tech Enabler needs additional support.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the reliability and day-to-day operation of multiple internal applications, deployment platforms, and supporting services.

  • Lead the investigation and resolution of incidents and deployment failures across cloud services, databases, identity, networking, secrets, and CI/CD systems.

  • Drive automation improvements across build, release, deployment, monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, rollback, and runbook processes.

  • Implement safe, well-tested code, configuration, infrastructure, and database fixes to restore or improve service reliability.

  • Develop proposals for cloud, hosting, database, and runtime migrations, as well as horizontal scaling approaches, supported by appropriate testing and rollback plans.

  • Build and maintain clear operational documentation, including runbooks, recovery procedures, incident fixes, and system knowledge that can be reused by other engineers.

  • Partner with software engineering, IT, security, identity, and external platform-support stakeholders to plan and execute infrastructure changes safely.

  • Provide overflow diagnostic and troubleshooting support for AI workflows and tools, including Langdock, without losing focus on core reliability priorities.

 

Who You Are

  • You take ownership of well-scoped technical work from investigation through testing, deployment, and follow-up.

  • You are calm and methodical when responding to live incidents and can diagnose problems across multiple interconnected systems.

  • You focus on root-cause resolution rather than repeatedly applying temporary fixes.

  • You communicate incidents, trade-offs, risks, and recovery plans clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are proactive about identifying reliability risks, automation opportunities, recurring issues, and operational improvements.

  • You make independent decisions on tactical fixes and safe configuration changes while seeking appropriate sign-off for architecture, migration, and scaling decisions.

  • You document changes and operational knowledge so that other engineers can support systems effectively.

  • You ask for help early when risks or dependencies are unclear and keep the Head of IT informed about significant issues and progress.

 

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong experience with Linux, networking, structured troubleshooting, and cloud hosting concepts.

  • Experience operating internal applications and deployment platforms in Azure or a comparable cloud environment.

  • Practical knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or an equivalent platform, including safe migration and recovery practices.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD tools such as OpenTofu, Terraform, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

  • Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, rollback automation, incident response, and service reliability practices.

  • Experience with horizontal scaling, stateless system design, migrations, and reversible change management.

  • Scripting and automation skills, together with experience reducing repetitive operational work.

  • Familiarity with identity and access management, least-privilege access, secrets management, FE’s internal AI/SaaS stack, and tools such as Langdock.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

Your mission

Own and evolve our AI engineering function — transforming a 15–20 person ML team from research-heavy to a high-throughput, production-grade organization. You’ll partner with the CTO on strategy, build the platform that unifies LLM access, RAG, and backend services, and ship reliable, scalable AI features that change how banks work.
 
Key responsibilities 

  • Team leadership and org build
    • Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team; set the technical bar, operating rhythms, and code/research review practices
    • Organize sub-teams (e.g., Core Modeling, AI Platform/Infra, Integrations) with clear ownership, SLOs, andon-call
    • Manage roadmap, capacity planning, and delivery across parallel initiatives
  • Architecture and platform
    • Own the LLM gateway: unified APIs and proxy layers for multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock), with rate limits, fallbacks, and cost tracking
    • Build high-performance RAG pipelines (ingestion, embeddings, vector stores, caching) with robust observability and safety guardrails
    • Partner with Java/NestJSteams to define clean async contracts, schemas, and eventing patterns; drive low-latency, scalable inference
  • Model lifecycle and operations
    • Lead end-to-end model and prompt lifecycle: data curation, training/fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, rollback
    • Establish LLMOps/MLOps: model/prompt registries, CI/CD, canary/A/B tests, offline/online evals, drift and cost monitoring
    • Optimizeinference throughput and cost (autoscaling, batching, quantization/distillation, caching)
  • Strategy and collaboration
    • Translate company goals into an AI/ML roadmap with measurable outcomes; balance exploration with reliability and cost
    • Own build-vs-buy/vendor strategy for models, infrastructure, and data services; manage budgets and SLAs
  • Governance and security
    • Implement data privacy, security, and compliance practices (RBAC, secrets, auditability); track prompt/model lineage and reproducibility
    • Define incident response, runbooks, and postmortems for AI features


Your profile

  • 5+ years as a backend engineer and 4+ years leading AI/ML engineering in production (10+ years total experience ideal)
  • Deep architecture expertise in Java (JVM) and/or Node.js (NestJS), distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and messaging/streaming
  • Hands-on with LLM stacks: orchestration (e.g.,LangChain/LlamaIndexor custom), vector DBs (Pinecone,Qdrant, FAISS), cloud AI (e.g., AWS Bedrock)
  • Proven operation of systems at scale (millions of daily API calls) with strong SLOs, observability, and incident management
  • MLOpsfoundations: model registries, experiment tracking, CI/CD, Kubernetes,IaC(e.g., Terraform), security best practices
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; strong product sense focused on shipping user-facing feature 
  • Fluent German and English for daily team collaboration, stakeholder management, and technical documentation
Nice to have 
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator serving and optimization (vLLM, TGI, Triton, ONNX Runtime)
  • Cost optimization for LLM workloads (token budgets, dynamic routing, caching)
  • Evaluation and safety/red-teaming for generative systems; startup/high-growth experience
Impact metrics 
  • Platform: adoption of a unified LLM gateway; standardized observability and cost reporting
  • Delivery: 2–3 user-facing AI features shipped with clear SLOs and measurable impact
  • Reliability/cost: reduced average latency and cost per request; autoscaling and caching in place
  • Org: sub-team structureestablished; improved code quality and on-time delivery; targeted hiring completed
Our stack  
  • Backend: Java (JVM), Node.js (NestJS); event-driven microservices; API gateways/proxies
  • AI platform: Python,PyTorch, LLM orchestration, prompt pipelines/registry; vector DBs (Pinecone,Qdrant); RAG services
  • Infra/DevOps: AWS (incl. Bedrock), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana)


Why us

  • Because we value talent more than hierarchy.
  • Because at neoshare, responsibility isn't delegated - it's owned.
  • Because we use modern AI and technology as a lever for exceptional results.
  • Because we develop people who want to learn, grow, and deliver.
  • Because performance, quality, and impact belong together for us.
  • Because we are working together towards building a European tech champion.

  • Legendary team events where we celebrate our wins together and strengthen team spirit.
  • State-of-the-art AI tools, first-class equipment, and an environment that fosters ownership and personal growth.
  • Concentration of top talent, fast decision-making, and the chance to make a real impact early on.
